convention_rule: Four similar objects in a left-to-right row; the single green-lit one marks the target by numeric ID (1st=P1 ... 4th=P4), independent of listing order (confirmed by r03, r04, r05).
basis: r06_A: four posts, green lantern on 2nd from left -> P2. r06_B is less clean: of four posts, the green-lit one is 3rd from left (P3), but P3 is the client-correct choice (lowest energy 20), so it cannot be the target. A is the clearer signal.
